name: Soybean Crush Spread (Gross Processing Margin)
description: Research study showing the soybean crush spread (gross processing margin) over time. Loads ZS (soybeans) as primary, ZM (soybean meal) and ZL (soybean oil) via reference_futures, all with NoAdjustment continuation. Computes GPM = (ZM × 0.024) + (ZL × 0.11) − (ZS / 100), plus 20d MA, expanding seasonal norm per calendar month, and seasonal deviation %. Outputs: summary table with current GPM, period high/low, seasonal norm, seasonal deviation, 20d MA; and a line chart with GPM, 20d MA, and seasonal norm overlaid.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SOYBEAN CRUSH SPREAD — GROSS PROCESSING MARGIN (GPM)
# =============================================================================
#
# GPM = (ZM × 0.024) + (ZL × 0.11) − (ZS / 100)
#
# Conversions:
#   ZM: $/short ton → $/bushel: multiply by 0.024 (1 bu soybeans → 48 lbs meal → 48/2000)
#   ZL: cents/lb → $/bushel: multiply by 0.11 (1 bu soybeans → 11 lbs oil)
#   ZS: cents/bushel → $/bushel: divide by 100
#
# All three use NoAdjustment to preserve real price levels for cross-commodity math.
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary: ZS (Soybeans) ---
src = market_data_source()()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
zs = zs_cont.c

# --- Reference: ZM (Soybean Meal) ---
zm_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_ref.o, zm_ref.h, zm_ref.l, zm_ref.c, zm_ref.v, zm_ref.oi, zm_ref.s)
zm = zm_cont.c

# --- Reference: ZL (Soybean Oil) ---
zl_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_ref.o, zl_ref.h, zl_ref.l, zl_ref.c, zl_ref.v, zl_ref.oi, zl_ref.s)
zl = zl_cont.c

# --- Gross Processing Margin (GPM) per bushel ---
gpm = (zm * 0.024) + (zl * 0.11) - (zs / 100.0)

# --- 20-day moving average of GPM ---
gpm_ma20 = ma(period=20)(gpm)

# --- Calendar month extraction for seasonal analysis ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Expanding seasonal norm per calendar month ---
is_jan = month_num == 1
is_feb = month_num == 2
is_mar = month_num == 3
is_apr = month_num == 4
is_may = month_num == 5
is_jun = month_num == 6
is_jul = month_num == 7
is_aug = month_num == 8
is_sep = month_num == 9
is_oct = month_num == 10
is_nov = month_num == 11
is_dec = month_num == 12

jan_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jan, gpm)))
feb_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_feb, gpm)))
mar_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_mar, gpm)))
apr_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_apr, gpm)))
may_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_may, gpm)))
jun_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jun, gpm)))
jul_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jul, gpm)))
aug_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_aug, gpm)))
sep_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_sep, gpm)))
oct_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_oct, gpm)))
nov_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_nov, gpm)))
dec_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_dec, gpm)))

seasonal_norm = conditional_select(
    is_jan, jan_avg,
    is_feb, feb_avg,
    is_mar, mar_avg,
    is_apr, apr_avg,
    is_may, may_avg,
    is_jun, jun_avg,
    is_jul, jul_avg,
    is_aug, aug_avg,
    is_sep, sep_avg,
    is_oct, oct_avg,
    is_nov, nov_avg,
    dec_avg
)

# --- Seasonal deviation (% from norm) ---
seasonal_dev = (gpm - seasonal_norm) / seasonal_norm

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — GPM Snapshot
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Soybean Crush Spread (GPM $/bushel)',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['GPM', 'Seasonal'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'High', 'Low'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Current GPM', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period High', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period Low', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Seasonal Norm', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Seasonal Dev %', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='20d MA', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot',
    order=0
)(gpm, gpm, gpm, seasonal_norm, seasonal_dev, gpm_ma20)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: GPM Line Chart with 20d MA & Seasonal Norm
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Spread — GPM Over Time',
    category='2. Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='GPM ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GPM', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Seasonal Norm', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(gpm, gpm_ma20, seasonal_norm))
